sources.name: Kenney
sources.verification: The pack's own License field and its included License.txt must both explicitly identify CC0.
sources.permittedPreview: Media contained inside the verified CC0 first-party asset archive.
sources.robots: Respect kenney.nl/robots.txt; fail closed on unavailable policy except HTTP 404/410.
sources.excluded: Creator logo branding, unrelated website content, paid tools, mirrors, and ambiguous licenses.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.verification: Current published asset license, API identity/authors, source HEAD reachability, and checksum-verified licensed diffuse texture.
sources.permittedPreview: Crop of an actual licensed diffuse texture from dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/Textures/.
sources.excluded: Website discovery scraping, website thumbnails/example renders, logos, user portraits, unrelated content, and unverified downloads.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.verification: Verify each product through its documented official API, explicit download-format attributes and reachable product page. Full archive contents and engine performance are not tested.
sources.permittedPreview: Exact API-listed material preview render: the source explicitly licenses these renders under CC0. Optimize locally and record the input hash.
sources.excluded: Logos, unrelated website images, private endpoints, unverified formats and non-material assets without a supported adapter.
